scope: Product-owned design-input, model-edit, serviceability and delivery repair; no Bench or evaluation changes
repairs: Validate edits against the actual V2 schema; normalize canonical dotted paths, numeric strings and serialized containers without guessing units
Reject unknown fields, wrong design owners, unsafe keys, conflicting paths and conversion-discarded edits atomically
No-op returns changed=false and transaction=null instead of reusing an earlier transaction
Expose actual schema discovery, canonical write targets, stable owner IDs and explicit input-to-model unit conversion
Preserve declared design basis, section b/t/imin and engineering input units through checker conversion
Differentiate ordinary confirmed text edits from evidence review; accept absent optional schema fields as proposals; invalid explicit mappings save no false resolution
Preserve semantic source review while retaining the hard requirement to map it to an actual model object before calculation
Use a verified whole-span/fixed-end serviceability reference for unambiguous 2D standalone beams; do not group frames or continuous beams implicitly
Canonical 2D recovery needs no invented inactive bending stiffness; 3D or nonzero inactive actions retain stiffness requirements
Validate service-result selection in agent and direct service; explicitly unselected cases have inapplicable service checks, never fabricated zero responses

browser.newRegressions: Original split numerical beam, serialized/dotted edits, real checks and reports in both languages

liveProvider.test: Live provider: confirmed design inputs survive edit, check and report

stages: cantilever imposed translation and rotation excluded

limits: A supplied numerical section is not certification of a rolled-section catalogue or its normative applicability
A qualitative restraint statement does not automatically provide phi_b or other missing numerical design conditions
Whole-span maxima remain explicitly sampled recovery results, not proofs of continuous extrema
These tests do not certify complete code coverage, every arbitrary LLM response or new commercial SDK paths
Production credentials/configuration, original conversations and historical results were not rewritten
